# Filtering

How a person narrows a collection, with filters in the Section's header in one of five tiers.

**Kind:** Pattern

**Storybook page:** `design-system/src/storybook-docs/patterns/Filtering/Filtering.mdx`

## Tiers

Choose a tier by the number of categories and the length of their lists. See Best practices for when to move filters into a menu.

- **1 · Quick filters.** One to three categories, each a short list: a "Field: value" trigger per category opening its own list, applied as you pick.
- **2a · Menu, one category.** The Filter icon button opens one list, applied as you pick. No footer.
- **2b · Menu, side by side.** Two or three categories with short lists in columns, with Clear and Apply at the end.
- **2c · Menu, stacked.** Four or more categories, or long lists, stacked, with Clear and Apply at the end.
- **3 · Filter side.** Filtering is the main job: a side at the Section's start, "Reset filters" at its top and a count beside each category. The Section does not place the side at its start itself yet; the example composes it.

## What is on

The control that holds a filter shows it: the FilterButton's count, or the Filter icon button's own count on the selected fill. No row of tags under the header.

## Key cases

### Below 960, the filter side

The side hides and the Filter button returns with its count. Pressing it gives the filters the Section's whole width, and "Show results" goes back. The Section does not build this takeover yet; the example composes it. The Section owns this behavior: Section › Width behavior.

### Widths

A one-list menu is auto: at least the trigger, 160 to 320, truncating with a tooltip. Side by side takes 3-col; stacked takes 3-col and never goes past 4-col. The widths are the Popup template's.

## Usage

Use Filtering when a person narrows a collection by its attributes. Filters live in the Section header's third row, after Search: "Field: value" triggers, then More filters. Views in the second row are not filters: a view is one of a fixed set, and filters combine.

| Tier | Use when | Controls | Applies | Shows it is on |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 · Quick filters | One to three categories, each a short list | A FilterButton per category | As you pick | The button's selected fill and count |
| 2a · Menu, one category | One category, and the bar has no room for a button | The Filter icon button, one list | As you pick | The Filter icon button's count |
| 2b · Menu, side by side | Two or three categories with short lists, applied together | The Filter icon button, columns, Clear and Apply | On Apply | The Filter icon button's count |
| 2c · Menu, stacked | Four or more categories, or long lists | The Filter icon button, stacked categories, Clear and Apply | On Apply | The Filter icon button's count |
| 3 · Filter side | Filtering is the main job, such as browsing a long catalog | A side at the Section's start | As you pick, or on "Apply filters" for a batch | A count beside each category |

## Alternatives

- For finding rows by name, use the Search pattern: its icon sits before the filters.
- For switching between fixed views of the rows, use `Tabs` as pill views.
- For sorting, use the `Table` column header: sorting is not a filter.

## Content guidelines

| Do | Don't |
| --- | --- |
| Name categories as nouns: "Grade", "School", "Subject". | "Filter by grade", "Choose a school". |
| Label the menu footer "Clear" and "Apply". | "Reset", "OK", "Done". |
| Put "Reset filters" at the top of a side; "Apply filters" only for a batch. | "Clear all", "Submit". |
| Name the Filter icon button with filters on: "Filters, 2 applied". | "Filters (2)". |
| Count the results in words: "1 of 8 students". | "1 result". |
| Go back from the filters on a narrow Section with "Show results". | "Done", "Close". |

## Accessibility

- The Filter icon button's name is "Filters"; with a count it reads "Filters, 2 applied". Apply returns focus to it, so its new name is read.
- A FilterButton's name is its text plus its count. Its list is a listbox the arrow keys move through; Escape closes it and returns focus to the button.
- The result count is a polite live region: it is read as the rows narrow.
- Clear and Apply are the last tab stops in a menu.
- A filter side is a region named "Filters", and each category is a group named by its legend.

## Parts

| Part | Component | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Quick filter | Filter button | A count only when a value is on; it hugs its label and opens its list at bottom-end. |
| Filter icon button | Filter menu trigger (Icon button) | The `filter` icon alone, named "Filters"; its `trailingMetric` draws the count on the selected fill. The Filter menu draws it unless you pass a `trigger`. |
| One list (tier 1 lists, 2a) | Popup select | Applies as you pick, radios for one. Checkboxes for several are Planned. |
| Filter menu (2b, 2c) | Filter menu | Holds values until Apply; columns side by side or stacked; Clear and Apply at the end. |
| Placement and width | Popup | bottom-end at the end of a bar, bottom-start at its start; 4 from the trigger. |
| Filter side | Section side | Composed at the start today. A start placement prop is Planned. |
| No matches | Empty state | Replaces the table and offers "Reset filters". |

## Related

- Section: use when the question is the header the filters sit in.
- Popup: use when the question is where a menu opens or how wide it is.
- Filter menu: use when building a tier 2b or 2c menu.
- Search: use for finding by name.
- Empty: use for No matches.
- Navigation: use for views.

## Motion

Filtering reads these motion tokens and no literal duration or curve.

| Event | Transition | Tokens | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| menu-open | Open and close an overlay | `--ds-motion-appearance-fast` | A filter menu fades in place under the Filter icon; nothing travels. |
| menu-close | Open and close an overlay | `--ds-motion-appearance-fast` | A filter menu fades closed. |
| count-first | Update a value or state | `--ds-motion-spatial-fast` · `--ds-motion-appearance-fast` | The first filter widens the Filter button to the left, right edge fixed, and the count fades in. A quick FilterButton's count hugs the label the same way. Below 960 a filter side hides with no animation: the Filter icon is back with its count in the same frame. |
| count-change | Update a value or state | `--ds-motion-appearance-fast` | The Filter count grows to the left; a changed number fades to its new value. |
| reset | Update a value or state | `--ds-motion-spatial-fast` · `--ds-motion-appearance-fast` | The count fades out, then the icon narrows back. |
| search | Update a value or state | `--ds-motion-spatial-fast` | Search grows to the left, right edge fixed, so the pills and the primary never move. Escape, or an empty blur, shrinks it back the same way; fast stays fast on exit. |
| tag | Add or remove an item | `--ds-motion-spatial-fast` · `--ds-motion-appearance-fast` | A tag being added or removed is Add or remove. |
| results | Swap content in place | `--ds-motion-appearance-fast` | The results swap in place, a clean fade, once per Apply. Typing in Search filters the list the same way. |
| results-load | Load content | `--ds-motion-appearance-fast` | When the fetch is slow, the results are Load. |

## Best practices

### Use one tier per bar. {#use-one-tier-per-bar}

**Checked:** Automatic

Quick filters and a filter menu never share a bar: some filters outside and some inside read as two systems. When a Section outgrows tier 1, all of its filters move into the menu. Where the filters sit in the header, and the header's order: Section › Order the header.

Do: One tier: three quick filters, all in the bar.
Don't: Two quick filters plus a Filter button: two systems in one bar.

### Keep the filters in the third row. {#keep-the-filters-in-the-third-row}

**Checked:** Automatic

The first two rows are for the title with its actions and for the views. The filters come after Search in the third row, so a person finds them in one place on every Section.

Do: Views in the second row; Search, then the filters, in the third.
Don't: The filters squeezed in beside the views.

### Show what is on through the control that holds it. {#show-what-is-on-through-the-control-that-holds-it}

**Checked:** Automatic

A FilterButton's count, the Filter icon button's count on the selected fill, or a count beside each category in a side. No separate count tag, and no row of tags under the bar.

Do: The count on the Filter icon button, on the selected fill.
Don't: A row of tags under the bar, repeating what is on.

### Apply one list as you pick and several categories on Apply. {#apply-one-list-as-you-pick-and-several-categories-on-apply}

**Checked:** Automatic

A one-list menu is a Popup select: radios for one choice, not searchable for a short list. Checkboxes for several choices in one list are Planned on it . A multi-category menu is a Filter menu that holds values until Apply; Apply closes it and updates the content once, and Clear clears the choices without applying. Where a menu opens and how wide it is: Popup.

### Say Clear in a menu and Reset filters everywhere else. {#say-clear-in-a-menu-and-reset-filters-everywhere-else}

**Checked:** Automatic

A menu's footer says "Clear" and "Apply", compact at the end. "Reset filters" at the top of a side clears them all, and the "No matches" state offers it too; both clear the search. "Apply filters" appears only for batch filtering in a side.

### Hide the filter side below 960 and fold quick filters below 768. {#hide-the-filter-side-below-960-and-fold-quick-filters-below-768}

**Checked:** Automatic

Below 960 the side hides and the Filter button returns with its count; pressing it gives the filters the Section's whole width, with "Show results" to go back: Section › Drop the Filter button while a filter side shows. Below 768 quick filters become a stacked menu.

## In code

From `design-system/src/storybook-docs/patterns/CodeExamples.stories.jsx#Filtering`.

```jsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Section } from '@/templates';

function QuickFilterExample() {
    const [status, setStatus] = useState('All');
    return (
        <Section
            title="Sessions"
            filters={[{
                key: 'status',
                label: 'Status',
                text: status,
                isSelected: status !== 'All',
                onClick: () => setStatus(STATUSES[(STATUSES.indexOf(status) + 1) % STATUSES.length]),
            }]}
        >
            <p role="status">Showing: {status}</p>
        </Section>
    );
}
```
